title: AddedFee billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = AddedFee (ebilling-r1 task 115; procedure-and-file-model.md 6.3, O-16). 12. An added fee (late fee, administrative fee, interest, other) is within its allowance: not allowed, a cap (an amount, or a percent of the invoice's other lines), or allowed after N days. The schema describes all three; PolicyVersionValidator refuses 'notAllowed' and 'afterDays' (rule_form_not_supported) until extraction returns a per-line fee kind and the due date, so only 'cap' is evaluated. A cap names the codes of the fee's lines and exactly one of capAmount and capPercent. Parameters only: no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.

feeKind.description: The kind of added fee the rule is about: lateFee, administrativeFee, interest or other.

allowance.description: notAllowed (the fee may not be billed), cap (at most capAmount or capPercent), or afterDays (allowed only afterDays days after the due date). Only cap is evaluated today.

feeCodes.description: cap: the expense codes of the invoice lines that carry this fee.

capAmount.description: cap: the most the fee lines may total on one invoice, in the invoice currency. More than 0.

capPercent.description: cap: the most the fee lines may total, as a percent of the invoice's other lines. More than 0, at most 100.

afterDays.description: afterDays: the fee is allowed only this many days after the invoice due date. 1 to 3650.

code.description: A code identifier from the resolved code set (e.g. a UTBMS expense code such as E101). The identifier only: descriptions are reference data.
